desc: Implement full solve() with two-sided checkpoint scheme (checkpoints, grid, per-query strips+corner)

Fix int64 overflow in grid construction: F(x_c,y_c) up to 2e21 overflows int64; accumulate per-block int64 sums (each ≤ 2e16) into Python ints for grid entries; ensure query-time ans starts as Python int and each added component is ≤ 2e16 (safe int64) before int() conversion
Verify correctness against sample inputs by reasoning through the decomposition (base grid + stripX + stripY + corner = full rectangle sum), including the overflow fix path
Check edge cases: x or y smaller than C (checkpoint index 0), x/y exactly at checkpoint (empty strips), duplicate values (side='left' handling), N < C (no checkpoints), K=1
Finalize code with fast I/O (sys.stdin.buffer), confirm C=1000 memory (~120MB) and runtime (~3s), output exactly the code block
